archetype: 1 - Organic & Earthy (Modified for Finance/Utility - High Contrast Trust)

brand_identity.name: BillBuster
brand_identity.target_audience: Indian small business owners, non-tech-savvy shopkeepers

rules: Use Hind for native Devanagari script support (Hindi/Marathi).
Headings must use Work Sans for clear, modern numeric readability.
Minimum tap target text should be 16px (text-base).
Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large numbers (e.g., ₹ amounts).

spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] bg-gray-50 flex flex-col relative shadow-xl overflow-hidden md:border md:border-gray-200

buttons.primary: w-full min-h-[56px] bg-green-600 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-lg shadow-sm hover:bg-green-700 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.danger: w-full min-h-[56px] bg-red-600 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-lg shadow-sm hover:bg-red-700 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: w-full min-h-[56px] bg-white text-gray-900 border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-xl font-semibold text-lg hover:border-gray-300 active:bg-gray-50 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2

cards.default: bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100
cards.result_pass: bg-green-50 p-6 rounded-2xl border-2 border-green-200 text-center
cards.result_fail: bg-red-50 p-6 rounded-2xl border-2 border-red-200 text-center

bottom_nav.container: w-full bg-white border-t border-gray-200 flex justify-around items-center h-20 pb-safe
bottom_nav.item: flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full gap-1 text-gray-500
bottom_nav.item_active: flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full gap-1 text-green-600 font-medium

icons_strategy.usage: Use large icons (w-12 h-12 to w-24 h-24) with circular background layers for emotional impact on result screens. Use 24x24 for bottom navigation.

invoice_success_hero.description: 3D illustration of an invoice with a green checkmark, used for zero-error success screens.

media_and_images.empty_state_strategy: Since generated images hit quota, heavily utilize Lucide icons (e.g., FileX, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle) encased in soft colored circles (bg-gray-100 p-6 rounded-full) as hero graphics for empty states.

animations.screen_transition: Slide in from right on navigate, slide out to right on back
animations.result_pop: scale up from 0.8 to 1 with spring physics for the success/error icons
animations.active_state: scale-[0.98] on active for all touchable elements (buttons, cards)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure red and green text meets APCA contrast standards. Use darker shades (700) against light backgrounds (50).
accessibility.language: UI must support Devanagari script natively without layout breakage.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All buttons, tabs, and result values must have a data-testid attribute.

key_screens_instructions.home: Top bar with Language Toggle and App Name. A prominent Monthly ITC Risk card. A massive 'Scan New Bill' primary button in the center.
key_screens_instructions.scanner: Simulated camera viewfinder (dark background with target box overlay). Includes a flash toggle icon and a prominent shutter button.
key_screens_instructions.result: Dramatic Pass/Fail UI. If fail, show '₹X,XXX ITC Loss' in giant red text, followed by extracted data (GSTIN, HSN, Taxable) in a card, and a clear 'Fix' explanation.
key_screens_instructions.history: Simple list view. Each row shows Vendor Name, Date, Amount, and a Green/Red indicator chip for status.
key_screens_instructions.help: WhatsApp-style chat interface for AI assistance.
